why.en: Foundational scholar of probabilistic graphical models and Coursera co-founder. Now runs the flagship commercialisation of AI for science — machine-learning-driven drug discovery with candidates entering the clinic.
why.zh: 概率图模型领域的奠基学者，Coursera 联合创始人。现以机器学习驱动药物发现，是 AI for Science 商业化的代表，候选药物已进入临床阶段。

title.zh: 药物发现没有魔杖

note.en: A direct response to the claim that superintelligence will simply cure cancer.

title.zh: Changing minds: How AI is transforming the life sciences

title.en: Only about a quarter of human diseases have an approved therapy. By some estimates it's a few percent. Most of those treatments slow a disease rather than stop

title.en: #93 – Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning
title.zh: #93 – Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning

note.en: Long-form Lex Fridman interview on biomedicine and machine learning, spanning her Stanford research, Coursera and insitro.
note.zh: Lex Fridman 长篇访谈，谈生物医学与机器学习，涵盖她在斯坦福的研究、Coursera 与 insitro。

title.en: Peptide-Spectra Matching from Weak Supervision
title.zh: Peptide-Spectra Matching from Weak Supervision

note.en: Uses weak supervision to match peptides to mass spectra without large labelled ground-truth datasets; she is senior author on the Google Brain and Calico collaboration.
note.zh: 用弱监督实现肽段与质谱的匹配，无需大规模标注真值数据；她是这项 Google Brain 与 Calico 合作研究的资深作者。

title.en: Inferring Multidimensional Rates of Aging from Cross-Sectional Data
title.zh: Inferring Multidimensional Rates of Aging from Cross-Sectional Data

note.en: Method for inferring individual multidimensional rates of aging from cross-sectional data, co-authored with Pierson, Koh, Leskovec and Liang.
note.zh: 提出从横截面数据推断个体多维衰老速率的方法，与 Pierson、Koh、Leskovec 和 Liang 合著。

title.en: insitro: Rethinking drug discovery using machine learning
title.zh: insitro: Rethinking drug discovery using machine learning

posts.source: Stories by Daphne Koller on Medium

note.en: Daphne Koller's own Medium post laid out insitro's founding thesis: using machine learning to rethink drug discovery.
note.zh: Daphne Koller在其Medium博客中阐述了insitro的创立理念：用机器学习重新构想药物研发。

title.en: Excited to join Calico and apply machine learning to improving human health https://t.co/XtBlHEVqyW. Come help build our world-class team!
title.zh: Excited to join Calico and apply machine learning to improving human health https://t.co/XtBlHEVqyW. Come help build our world-class team!

note.en: Koller announced she was joining Calico to apply machine learning to human health research.
note.zh: Koller宣布加入Calico,将机器学习应用于人类健康研究。

title.en: Thrilled to work w/ @IllinoisCS to launch a top-ranked master's degree in data science offered entirely on Coursera! https://t.co/dE01XjnPaX
title.zh: Thrilled to work w/ @IllinoisCS to launch a top-ranked master's degree in data science offered entirely on Coursera! https://t.co/dE01XjnPaX

note.en: Koller launched a top-ranked online master's degree in data science with the University of Illinois, delivered entirely through Coursera.
note.zh: Koller与伊利诺伊大学合作,通过Coursera推出一个排名靠前的在线数据科学硕士学位项目。

title.en: Tuned Models of Peer Assessment in MOOCs
title.zh: Tuned Models of Peer Assessment in MOOCs

note.en: Models that make peer grading more accurate at MOOC scale, from her Coursera-era work with Chris Piech and Andrew Ng.
note.zh: 提出在 MOOC 规模下提升同伴评分准确度的模型，来自她 Coursera 时期与 Chris Piech、吴恩达的合作。

title.en: Probability Estimation in Face of Irrelevant Information
title.zh: Probability Estimation in Face of Irrelevant Information

note.en: Early work with Adam Grove on how a decision-theoretic agent should estimate probabilities when much of what it observes is irrelevant.
note.zh: 与 Adam Grove 合作的早期工作，研究决策论智能体在观测中大量信息无关时应如何估计概率。

title.en: Generating New Beliefs From Old
title.zh: Generating New Beliefs From Old

note.en: Continues the random-worlds line of work on deriving degrees of belief from a knowledge base as new information arrives.
note.zh: 延续「随机世界」方法的研究，探讨在获得新信息时如何从知识库导出信念度。

title.en: Stochastic Simulation Algorithms for Dynamic Probabilistic Networks
title.zh: Stochastic Simulation Algorithms for Dynamic Probabilistic Networks

note.en: Stochastic sampling algorithms for approximate posterior inference in dynamic probabilistic networks.
note.zh: 提出用于动态概率网络近似后验推断的随机采样算法。

title.en: Context-Specific Independence in Bayesian Networks
title.zh: Context-Specific Independence in Bayesian Networks

note.en: Introduces context-specific independence, a finer-grained notion of independence that yields more compact Bayesian networks and faster inference.
note.zh: 提出「上下文特定独立性」，一种更细粒度的独立性概念，可获得更紧凑的贝叶斯网络与更快的推断。

title.en: Nonuniform Dynamic Discretization in Hybrid Networks
title.zh: Nonuniform Dynamic Discretization in Hybrid Networks

note.en: Revisits variable discretization for inference in hybrid networks that mix continuous and discrete variables in arbitrary topologies.
note.zh: 重新审视混合网络中的变量离散化问题，这类网络在任意拓扑下同时包含连续与离散变量。

title.en: Object-Oriented Bayesian Networks
title.zh: Object-Oriented Bayesian Networks

note.en: Introduces object-oriented Bayesian networks, letting large domains be assembled from reusable model components.
note.zh: 提出面向对象贝叶斯网络，使大型领域模型可以由可复用的组件搭建。

title.en: Update Rules for Parameter Estimation in Bayesian Networks
title.zh: Update Rules for Parameter Estimation in Bayesian Networks

note.en: Recasts parameter estimation in Bayesian networks with missing values and hidden variables using online-learning update rules.
note.zh: 借助在线学习的更新规则，重新表述含缺失值与隐变量的贝叶斯网络参数估计问题。

title.en: Tractable Inference for Complex Stochastic Processes
title.zh: Tractable Inference for Complex Stochastic Processes

note.en: Shows that approximation error stays bounded over time when monitoring a stochastic process, the contraction result that makes practical filtering in dynamic Bayesian networks possible.
note.zh: 证明在监测随机过程时近似误差随时间保持有界，这一收缩性结果使动态贝叶斯网络的实用滤波成为可能。

title.en: SPOOK: A System for Probabilistic Object-Oriented Knowledge Representation
title.zh: SPOOK: A System for Probabilistic Object-Oriented Knowledge Representation

note.en: SPOOK, a working system for probabilistic object-oriented knowledge representation built on her object-oriented Bayesian network language.
note.zh: SPOOK，一个基于她的面向对象贝叶斯网络语言构建的概率式面向对象知识表示系统。

title.en: A General Algorithm for Approximate Inference and its Application to Hybrid Bayes Nets
title.zh: A General Algorithm for Approximate Inference and its Application to Hybrid Bayes Nets

note.en: Generalises the clique tree algorithm so approximate inference also works in hybrid Bayesian networks.
note.zh: 推广团树算法，使近似推断同样适用于混合贝叶斯网络。

title.en: Discovering the Hidden Structure of Complex Dynamic Systems
title.zh: Discovering the Hidden Structure of Complex Dynamic Systems

note.en: Learns the structure of dynamic Bayesian networks, hidden variables included, for complex systems where no expert model exists.
note.zh: 在没有专家模型可用的复杂系统中，学习包含隐变量的动态贝叶斯网络结构。

title.en: Probabilistic Models for Agents' Beliefs and Decisions
title.zh: Probabilistic Models for Agents' Beliefs and Decisions

note.en: A probabilistic framework for reasoning about the beliefs and decisions of other agents, including their beliefs about each other.
note.zh: 提出一个概率框架，用于推理其他智能体的信念与决策，包括它们彼此之间的信念。

title.en: Policy Iteration for Factored MDPs
title.zh: Policy Iteration for Factored MDPs

note.en: Policy iteration that exploits factored structure to solve very large MDPs represented as dynamic Bayesian networks.
note.zh: 利用因子化结构的策略迭代方法，用以求解以动态贝叶斯网络表示的超大规模 MDP。

title.en: Being Bayesian about Network Structure
title.zh: Being Bayesian about Network Structure

note.en: With Nir Friedman, reasons over the full posterior across network structures instead of selecting a single model, giving better answers about which variable causes which.
note.zh: 与 Nir Friedman 合作，在网络结构的完整后验上进行推理而非只选择单一模型，从而更好地判断变量之间的依赖关系。

title.en: Utilities as Random Variables: Density Estimation and Structure Discovery
title.zh: Utilities as Random Variables: Density Estimation and Structure Discovery

note.en: Treats a person's utility as a random variable like any other domain attribute, enabling density estimation and structure discovery over utility functions.
note.zh: 把个人效用视为与其他领域属性一样的随机变量，从而可以对效用函数做密度估计与结构发现。

title.en: Exact Inference in Networks with Discrete Children of Continuous Parents
title.zh: Exact Inference in Networks with Discrete Children of Continuous Parents

note.en: Early graphical-models paper on exact inference in hybrid Bayesian networks with discrete children of continuous parents.
note.zh: 她在概率图模型方向的早期论文，研究连续父节点带离散子节点的混合贝叶斯网络中的精确推断。

title.en: Discriminative Probabilistic Models for Relational Data
title.zh: Discriminative Probabilistic Models for Relational Data

note.en: Relational Markov networks: discriminative models for labelling entities whose labels depend on one another, with Ben Taskar and Pieter Abbeel.
note.zh: 关系马尔可夫网络：与 Ben Taskar、Pieter Abbeel 合作，为标签相互依赖的实体提出判别式标注模型。

title.en: Continuous Time Bayesian Networks
title.zh: Continuous Time Bayesian Networks

note.en: Introduces continuous time Bayesian networks, a language for structured stochastic processes that evolve in continuous rather than discrete time.
note.zh: 提出连续时间贝叶斯网络，一种描述在连续时间而非离散时间上演化的结构化随机过程的语言。

title.en: Monitoring a Complez Physical System using a Hybrid Dynamic Bayes Net
title.zh: Monitoring a Complez Physical System using a Hybrid Dynamic Bayes Net

note.en: Applies a hybrid dynamic Bayesian network to unsupervised fault monitoring of a system designed to produce oxygen from the Martian atmosphere.
note.zh: 将混合动态贝叶斯网络用于无人监督的故障监测，对象是一套从火星大气中制取氧气的系统。

title.en: Learning Hierarchical Object Maps Of Non-Stationary Environments with mobile robots
title.zh: Learning Hierarchical Object Maps Of Non-Stationary Environments with mobile robots

note.en: Robot mapping that represents non-stationary environments as hierarchies of objects rather than static unstructured maps.
note.zh: 机器人建图方法，将非静态环境表示为对象的层次结构，而非静态的无结构地图。

title.en: Learning Module Networks
title.zh: Learning Module Networks

note.en: Module networks share parameters across related variables so structure can be learned from few samples, applied to gene expression data.
note.zh: 模块网络在相关变量间共享参数，使得少量样本也能学出结构，并应用于基因表达数据。

title.en: insitro acquires CombinAbleAI and launches the TherML platform
title.zh: insitro 收购 CombinAbleAI 并发布 TherML 平台

body.en: An end-to-end, modality-agnostic system for designing small molecules, antibodies, oligonucleotides and other complex biologics. First development candidate CTRO-1013 nominated, CMC initiated, first-in-human trial design finalised, clinic targeted for 2026.
body.zh: 端到端、模态无关的系统，可设计小分子、抗体、寡核苷酸等复杂生物制剂。首个候选药 CTRO-1013 已提名，CMC 启动，首次人体试验设计定稿，目标 2026 年进入临床。
